title: KiRA: Kronecker Input-Gated Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33236v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Full fine-tuning of large pretrained models is expensive, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is the standard alternative. Most PEFT methods use low-rank updates, whose rank lies far below that of full fine-tuning and is the same for every input. Input-adaptive variants vary the capacity per input but remain within the low-rank bottleneck, and whether a task benefits from input conditioning is not known before training. This paper introduces Kronecker input-gated rank adaptation (KiRA). Instead of the conventional low-rank product, the update $\Delta W$ is the Kronecker product of a frozen random $p\times p$ matrix $A$ and a trainable factor $M(x)$, which overcomes the rank ceiling: because rank is multiplicative under this product, $A$ multiplies the rank of $M(x)$ by $p$ without adding trainable parameters. translated_title: KiRA：面向预训练模型参数高效微调的Kronecker输入门控秩自适应方法
translated_abstract: 对大型预训练模型进行全量微调代价高昂，参数高效微调（PEFT）是标准的替代方案。大多数PEFT方法采用低秩更新，其秩远低于全量微调，且对所有输入都是相同的。输入自适应变体虽然可以针对每个输入调整容量，但仍受限于低秩瓶颈，而且任务是否能从输入条件化中获益在训练前是未知的。本文提出Kronecker输入门控秩自适应（KiRA）。该方法不再使用传统的低秩乘积，而是将更新 $\Delta W$ 表示为冻结的随机 $p\times p$ 矩阵 $A$ 与可训练因子 $M(x)$ 的Kronecker积，从而突破秩上限：由于秩在该乘积下具有相乘特性，$A$ 可以将 $M(x)$ 的秩放大 $p$ 倍，而不增加任何可训练参数。因子 $M(x)$ 进一步分解为 $B_1\,\mathrm{diag}(g(x))\,B_2$，其中输入门控 $g(x)$ 仅需计算一次……
tldr: KiRA将微调更新表示为冻结随机矩阵与输入门控可训练因子的Kronecker积，在不增加可训练参数的前提下突破低秩PEFT方法的秩上限，实现参数高效的输入自适应微调。
en_tdlr: KiRA overcomes the rank ceiling of low-rank PEFT methods by formulating the fine-tuning update as a Kronecker product of a frozen random matrix and an input-gated trainable factor, multiplying the achievable rank by p without adding any trainable parameters.
